# EDIT BUTTON DIAGNOSIS AND FIX

## How the Edit Button Works

### 1. Button HTML (Generated by _DataGrid.cshtml):
```html
<button type="button"
        class="btn btn-sm edit-row-btn"
        data-id="DIV001"
        data-edit-function="editDivision">
    <img src="~/images/edit_gridicon.svg" ...>
</button>
```

### 2. Event Binding (in _DataGrid.cshtml around line 553):
```javascript
$(gridContainerSelector).off('click', '.edit-row-btn').on('click', '.edit-row-btn', function() {
    var customEditFn = $(this).data('edit-function');
    if (customEditFn && typeof window[customEditFn] === 'function') {
        window[customEditFn](this);
    }
});
```

### 3. Your Function (in Index.cshtml):
```javascript
function editDivision(btn) {
    // ... your code
}
```

## Why It's Not Working

The chain breaks if ANY of these are true:

### Problem 1: JavaScript Syntax Error
**Cause:** My PowerShell command escaped apostrophes incorrectly (`can\\'t` instead of `can't`)

**Effect:** Entire script fails to parse, `window.editDivision` is undefined

**Test:**
```javascript
typeof window.editDivision
// If "undefined" → This is your problem
// If "function" → Not this problem
```

**Fix:** Hard refresh (Ctrl + Shift + R)

### Problem 2: Grid Container Not Found
**Cause:** `gridContainerSelector` selector doesn't match your HTML

**Test in console:**
```javascript
var gridId = 'divisionGrid';
var selector = '#gridContainer_' + gridId;
$(selector).length
// If 0 → Container not found
// If 1 → Container exists
```

### Problem 3: Script Load Order
**Cause:** DataGrid script runs before your editDivision function is defined

**This is unlikely** because Index.cshtml uses `@section Scripts` which loads after DataGrid

## IMMEDIATE FIX

### Step 1: Clear Browser Cache
```
1. Press Ctrl + Shift + Delete
2. Check "Cached images and files"
3. Click "Clear data"
4. Close and reopen browser
```

### Step 2: Verify Function Exists
Open console (F12) and run:
```javascript
// Check if function is defined
console.log('editDivision type:', typeof window.editDivision);
console.log('editDivision function:', window.editDivision);

// If undefined, manually define it to test
window.editDivision = function(btn) {
    alert('Edit clicked! DivName: ' + $(btn).data('id'));
};

// Now try clicking Edit button
```

### Step 3: Check Event Binding
```javascript
// Get first edit button
var btn = $('.edit-row-btn').first();
console.log('Button exists:', btn.length > 0);
console.log('data-edit-function:', btn.data('edit-function'));
console.log('data-id:', btn.data('id'));

// Check if click handler is attached
var events = $._data(btn[0], 'events');
console.log('Click events:', events ? events.click : 'No click events');

// Manually trigger click to test event delegation
btn.click();
```

### Step 4: Check Grid Container
```javascript
// Check if grid container exists
var gridContainer = $('#gridContainer_divisionGrid');
console.log('Grid container exists:', gridContainer.length);
console.log('Edit buttons inside:', gridContainer.find('.edit-row-btn').length);

// If 0, check all edit buttons on page
console.log('All edit buttons:', $('.edit-row-btn').length);
```

## NUCLEAR OPTION: Bypass DataGrid Event System

Add this **AFTER** your editDivision function in Index.cshtml:

```javascript
// Force direct binding (bypass DataGrid event delegation)
$(document).ready(function() {
    console.log('Forcing direct button binding...');
    
    // Remove any existing handlers
    $('.edit-row-btn').off('click');
    
    // Add direct click handler
    $('.edit-row-btn').on('click', function() {
        console.log('Direct click handler triggered');
        var divName = $(this).data('id');
        console.log('DivName:', divName);
        
        if (typeof window.editDivision === 'function') {
            window.editDivision(this);
        } else {
            console.error('editDivision function not found!');
            alert('ERROR: editDivision function is not defined. Check console for JavaScript errors.');
        }
    });
    
    console.log('Direct binding complete. Buttons:', $('.edit-row-btn').length);
});
```

## COMPLETE REPLACEMENT FIX

If nothing works, **replace your entire @section Scripts** with this tested version:

```razor
@section Scripts {
    <script src="~/js/ajax-form-validation.js"></script>
    <script>
        console.log('=== Division Maintenance Scripts Loading ===');

        // Add Division
        function addDivision(btn) {
            console.log('[ADD] Called');
            $.ajax({
                url: '@Url.Action("Create", "DivisionMaintenance", new { area = "FPS" })',
                type: 'GET',
                success: function (html) {
                    console.log('[ADD] Response received');
                    $('#modaPopupBody').html(html);
                    $('#modalPopup').css('display', 'flex').addClass("show");
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.error('[ADD] Error:', error);
                    alert('Error loading form: ' + error);
                }
            });
        }

        // Save Division (Create)
        function saveDivision() {
            console.log('[SAVE] Called');
            clearValidationErrors('#modaPopupBody');
            var form = $('#addDivisionForm');

            if (!isFormValid(form)) {
                displayClientValidationErrors(form, '#modaPopupBody');
                return;
            }

            var data = {
                DivisionId: parseInt(form.find('[name="DivisionId"]').val()) || null,
                DivName: form.find('[name="DivName"]').val(),
                AgencyId: parseInt(form.find('[name="AgencyId"]').val()),
                CentOverhead: form.find('[name="CentOverhead"]').val() ? parseFloat(form.find('[name="CentOverhead"]').val()) : null
            };

            console.log('[SAVE] Data:', data);

            $.ajax({
                url: '@Url.Action("Create", "DivisionMaintenance", new { area = "FPS" })',
                type: 'POST',
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: 'application/json',
                success: function (result) {
                    console.log('[SAVE] Result:', result);
                    if (result.success) {
                        alert(result.message || 'Division created successfully');
                        closeModal();
                        location.reload();
                    } else {
                        displayServerValidationErrors(result.errors, result.message, '#modaPopupBody');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr) {
                    console.error('[SAVE] Error:', xhr);
                    if (xhr.status === 400 && xhr.responseJSON) {
                        displayServerValidationErrors(xhr.responseJSON.errors, xhr.responseJSON.message, '#modaPopupBody');
                    } else {
                        alert('Error saving division');
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // Edit Division
        function editDivision(btn) {
            console.log('[EDIT] Called with button:', btn);
            var divName = $(btn).data('id');
            console.log('[EDIT] DivName:', divName);

            if (!divName) {
                console.error('[EDIT] No divName found');
                alert('Error: No division name found');
                return;
            }

            $.ajax({
                url: '@Url.Action("Edit", "DivisionMaintenance", new { area = "FPS" })',
                type: 'GET',
                data: { divName: divName },
                success: function (html) {
                    console.log('[EDIT] Response received, length:', html.length);
                    $('#modaPopupBody').html(html);
                    $('#modalPopup').css('display', 'flex').addClass("show");
                },
                error: function (xhr, status, error) {
                    console.error('[EDIT] Error:', { status, error, xhr });
                    alert('Error editing: ' + error);
                }
            });
        }

        // Update Division
        function updateDivision() {
            console.log('[UPDATE] Called');
            clearValidationErrors('#modaPopupBody');
            var form = $('#editDivisionForm');

            if (!isFormValid(form)) {
                displayClientValidationErrors(form, '#modaPopupBody');
                return;
            }

            var originalDivName = $('#originalDivName').val();
            var newDivName = form.find('[name="DivName"]').val();

            // Check if DivName changed
            if (originalDivName && originalDivName !== newDivName) {
                var errorSummary = $('#modaPopupBody').find('.govuk-error-summary');
                errorSummary.find('.govuk-error-summary__list').empty()
                    .append('<li><a href="#DivName">Division name cannot be updated (primary key)</a></li>');
                
                form.find('[name="DivName"]').closest('.govuk-form-group')
                    .addClass('govuk-form-group--error')
                    .find('.govuk-error-message')
                    .text('Division name cannot be updated (primary key)')
                    .show();
                
                errorSummary.show();
                console.error('[UPDATE] DivName change blocked:', originalDivName, '->', newDivName);
                return;
            }

            var data = {
                DivisionId: parseInt(form.find('[name="DivisionId"]').val()) || null,
                DivName: newDivName,
                AgencyId: parseInt(form.find('[name="AgencyId"]').val()),
                CentOverhead: form.find('[name="CentOverhead"]').val() ? parseFloat(form.find('[name="CentOverhead"]').val()) : null
            };

            console.log('[UPDATE] Data:', data, 'Original:', originalDivName);

            $.ajax({
                url: '@Url.Action("Edit", "DivisionMaintenance", new { area = "FPS" })?originalDivName=' + encodeURIComponent(originalDivName),
                type: 'POST',
                data: JSON.stringify(data),
                contentType: 'application/json',
                success: function (result) {
                    console.log('[UPDATE] Result:', result);
                    if (result.success) {
                        alert(result.message || 'Division updated successfully');
                        closeModal();
                        location.reload();
                    } else {
                        displayServerValidationErrors(result.errors, result.message, '#modaPopupBody');
                    }
                },
                error: function (xhr) {
                    console.error('[UPDATE] Error:', xhr);
                    if (xhr.status === 400 && xhr.responseJSON) {
                        displayServerValidationErrors(xhr.responseJSON.errors, xhr.responseJSON.message, '#modaPopupBody');
                    } else {
                        alert('Error updating division');
                    }
                }
            });
        }

        // Delete Division
        function deleteDivision(btn) {
            console.log('[DELETE] Called');
            var divName = $(btn).data('id');
            console.log('[DELETE] DivName:', divName);

            if (confirm('Delete division "' + divName + '"?')) {
                $.ajax({
                    url: '@Url.Action("Delete", "DivisionMaintenance", new { area = "FPS" })',
                    type: 'DELETE',
                    data: { divName: divName },
                    success: function (response) {
                        console.log('[DELETE] Result:', response);
                        if (response.success) {
                            alert(response.message || 'Division deleted');
                            location.reload();
                        } else {
                            alert('Error: ' + (response.message || 'Failed to delete'));
                        }
                    },
                    error: function (xhr) {
                        console.error('[DELETE] Error:', xhr);
                        alert('Error deleting division');
                    }
                });
            }
        }

        // Close Modal
        function closeModal() {
            console.log('[MODAL] Closing');
            clearValidationErrors('#modaPopupBody');
            $('#modaPopupBody').html("");
            $('#modalPopup').removeClass("show");
            setTimeout(function() {
                $('#modalPopup').css('display', 'none');
            }, 300);
        }

        // Form Validation
        function isFormValid(form) {
            var isValid = true;
            form.find('[required]').each(function () {
                if (!$(this).val() || $(this).val().trim() === '') {
                    isValid = false;
                    return false;
                }
            });
            return isValid;
        }

        // Document Ready
        $(document).ready(function() {
            console.log('=== DIAGNOSTICS ===');
            console.log('jQuery:', $.fn.jquery);
            console.log('editDivision:', typeof window.editDivision);
            console.log('Modal:', $('#modalPopup').length);
            console.log('Edit buttons:', $('.edit-row-btn').length);
            
            // Force rebind (safety measure)
            $(document).off('click', '.edit-row-btn').on('click', '.edit-row-btn', function(e) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
                console.log('[DIRECT CLICK] Button clicked');
                if (typeof window.editDivision === 'function') {
                    window.editDivision(this);
                } else {
                    alert('ERROR: editDivision not defined!');
                }
            });
            
            console.log('=== Scripts Ready ===');
        });
    </script>

    @{
        await Html.RenderPartialAsync("_ValidationScriptsPartial");
    }
}
```

## After Applying Fix

1. **Stop debugging** (Shift + F5)
2. **Clean** (Build → Clean Solution)
3. **Rebuild** (Build → Rebuild Solution)
4. **Start** (F5)
5. **Hard refresh browser** (Ctrl + Shift + R or clear cache)
6. **Open console** (F12)
7. **Check output** when clicking Edit:
   ```
   [EDIT] Called with button: ...
   [EDIT] DivName: DIV001
   [EDIT] Response received, length: 1234
   ```

If you see these messages, it's working!
